pivot.reason: The audit found two unsafe evidence claims in the same sidecar pass: synthetic semantic/routing scores and event identity fields derived from model/UI labels. Both could be corrected locally without embedding or persistence.

progress.delta: No task checkbox closed; task 4.2 remains open pending actual canonical embedding dispatch.

findings.evidence: The sidecar constructs semantic_cards, but no current consumer was found dispatching those cards to the existing semantic_768 embedding owner.
The semantic pass emitted dense_cosine, KMeans/SOM/manifold distances, and semantic_confidence solely from whether cards existed.
Event hypergraph construction used model_id/document_id/default strings for workspace_revision, packet_key, and representation_revision.

implementation: Semantic pass now identifies itself as semantic-card-builder v1, emits no fabricated measured features, and reports embedding_status=NOT_RUN plus SEMANTIC_768_EMBEDDING_NOT_RUN.
ExperimentFeatureMatrix representation_revision remains null without an embedding receipt, even if AnalyzeRequest.model_id is supplied.
Event hypergraph requires explicit source_ref, source_revision, workspace_revision, and packet_key; otherwise it returns status=SKIPPED_LINEAGE with no events.
Event hypergraph representation_revision is null until an embedding receipt exists.
